spans.s: (cf. √ ह्रुड्, हुड्, होड् &c.) cl. 1. P. हूडति, to go, Dhātup. ix, 68.
a ram, L.; VarBṛS. (v.l.)
a partic. implement of war, MBh.
a bar or iron rod for keeping out thieves, MW.
(accord. to some) a place for voiding excrement, ib.
हुड—रोमाश्रय-फला f. a kind of shrub, L.
a ram, L.
an onomat. sound, Sarvad.
हुडुक्—कार m. (with Pāśupatas) a kind of chuckling, ib.
a kind of rattle or small drum, L.
a kind of bird in rut (Gallinula Madraspatana = दात्यूह), L.
a drunken man, L.
a stick or staff bound with iron, L.
the bar or bolt of a door, L.
(आ), f. a kind of drum, Saṃgīt.
v.l. for हुडुक्क.
हुडुक्क—हिक्का f. the sound of a little hand-drum, L.
= हुडुक्, KāśīKh.
the noise of a bull, L.
हुडुत्—कार m. = हुडुक्-क्˚, KāśīKh.
= हुडुत् (in हुडुं-कृत्य), ib.
= भ्रष्ट-चिपिट, L.
